abstract: Documents vendor corporate experience and historical operational tenure
system_message:
You are the Commercial contract administrator (CON). Your responsibilities include documenting vendor corporate experience and historical operational tenure, as well as maintaining corporate credit risk evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Corporate credit risk evaluation（FINAN）
information_points.content:
CON-FINAN-H91：According to the independent credit rating dossier evaluating prime contractor balance sheet and solvency metrics, Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers achieves a corporate financial stability score of 80 points on the consolidated commercial solvency assessment index.
CON-FINAN-88D：According to the independent credit rating dossier evaluating prime contractor balance sheet and solvency metrics, Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture achieves a corporate financial stability score of 90 points on the consolidated commercial solvency assessment index.
CON-FINAN-UFW：According to the independent credit rating dossier evaluating prime contractor balance sheet and solvency metrics, On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis achieves a corporate financial stability score of 70 points on the consolidated commercial solvency assessment index.

information_points.title: Documents vendor corporate experience and historical operational tenure（COMM）
information_points.content:
CON-COMM-82K：For Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers, the corporate qualification dossier records contractor operational experience of 3 yr across continuous commercial heavy-duty fleet supply contracts operating utility-scale hydrogen delivery.
CON-COMM-VCM：For On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis, the corporate qualification dossier records contractor operational experience of 3 yr across continuous commercial heavy-duty fleet supply contracts operating utility-scale hydrogen delivery.
CON-COMM-5RW：For Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture, the corporate qualification dossier documents contractor operational experience of 10 yr in continuous commercial heavy-duty fleet supply contracts operating utility-scale hydrogen delivery.
